buildingFootprintProvenance.source: Dirección General del Catastro · INSPIRE Buildings
buildingFootprintProvenance.method: Above-ground building parts; parent fallbacks when no usable part exists; topology-preserving simplification 0.18 m; preserved courtyard holes; WGS84 coordinates; non-overlapping OSM complement. Elevation uses source heights, normalized surface estimates, floor counts or a marked visual fallback.
buildingFootprintProvenance.note: Derived atlas product, not official cadastral information or a current facade survey.

surfaceHeightProvenance.source: IGN / CNIG · MDSnE2.5, normalized building surface model
surfaceHeightProvenance.source_period: First PNOA-LiDAR coverage; individual flight date not verified
surfaceHeightProvenance.method: 60th percentile of positive height-above-ground raster cells centered inside each mapped footprint; require at least3 valid samples and45% positive coverage. OSM height/levels untouched. Small/unmatched buildings retain renderer fallback.
surfaceHeightProvenance.caution: Raster-derived roof-height estimates; not measured facade/eaves heights and not verified current as-built condition.
